children: The Authenticity and Modernity Party (PAM) won the largest number of seats in Morocco's legislative election on Wednesday, followed by its partners in the outgoing government, RNI, and the Istiqlal party, according to official preliminary results.
Liberal-centrist PAM took 97 seats in the 395-member parliament, ahead of the RNI with 66, while the Istiqlal Party secured 65 seats, the interior minister said in a press briefing.
